name: VoidSanction
install_msg:
Thank you for installing **VoidSanction**, a fork of AAA3A's SimpleSanction.
Load it with `[p]load voidsaction` then use `[p]voidsanction @member`.
Set per-action GIFs with `[p]setvoidsanction gif set <action> <url>`. Nullvoid uses the Void cog meme from `[p]nullvoidset`.
short: Button sanction menu with cleanup prompts, Void/NullVoid, delayed self-clean, and per-action GIFs.
description: A modern fork of SimpleSanction. Kick/ban ask how many days of messages to delete (0-7). Void and NullVoid call the Shadcodez Void cog; nullvoid keeps that cog's own meme GIF and cleanup. The menu deletes itself 10 seconds after an action or after 2.5 minutes idle. Optional per-action GIF URLs post before the sanction and delete 15 seconds after it finishes.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store data or metadata about users.
